notes.title: GLADIUM 1.1 - HORDE
notes.content:
[b]Gladium 1.1 is here![/b]
Thanks for all the great feedback from the 1.0 launch! I have made a lot of changes to the core gameplay with some new additions as well. 

[b]Featuring:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]A new game mode as well as an update to the current one![/b] 
[b]Classic:[/b] Fight increasing amounts of enemies until you are victorious. Great rewards for those who succeed, but none for those who fail. 
[b]Horde:[/b] Fight endlessly for your life and gain rewards based on how far you get.
[*] [b]More music![/b] Two new soundtracks curtesy of SB Studios.
[*] [b]Improved hitboxes[/b]  
[*] [b]And much more![/b]
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1118410/discussions/0/1745644917624415457/]Check Out the Patch notes for additional info[/url]

notes.title: Gladium is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hail Gladiators![/h3]
[b]Spread the word and leave a review! I want the arena filled with as much blood as possible!
As gratitude for you wanting to play the game now, I have included a 10% discount.[/b]

[u][b]Going forward[/b][/u]
Straight away I'm going to be making sure that the launch goes as smoothly as possible. Any issues or bugs you find, report in the community hub. This will have my top priority.
After this is done I will begin development on the next content for Gladium. Here I will work on a new boss, equipment, leaderboards(see below), general polish, etc.

[u][b]Note[/b][/u]
I have opened up threads for suggestions and bugs on our Community Hub.
Leaderboard functionality is very basic now, and I will require many people to play Endless Mode before this will be improved. I am planning to have atleast three different leaderboard modes: Highest scores, your position and one for just your Steam friends. As the game is challenging and Endless Mode is locked until you have beaten the (current) last boss, this will probably take a little while for players to get there.

If you run into any issues feel free to email me at: wiklundgames@gmail.com or make a thread in the Community Hub.

Good luck and see you in the arena!
- Eirik

notes.title: End of beta
notes.content:
[h1]The Gladium beta is now finished[/h1]
Hope you all had a blast! 
Thanks for all the wonderful feedback.
If you haven't filled out the feedback form, please do so. The link is in the beta-invite mail.

[b]Remember to put the game on your steam wishlist to get notified when the game launches![/b]
After the beta ended the game is removed from the wishlist because you had a test-version in your library.


[b]Changes in Gladium going forward[/b]
Now that I've gathered some feedback and watched some of you play there's a number of improvements that I'm going to be working on until the Early Access launch.

[u]Enemies[/u]
The enemy AI and specifically their telegraphing are going to be experimented with and improved. When enemies are blocking, boss attacks and generally better visual clarity while fighting.

[u]Pit fighting[/u]
I have some exciting plans to make this into a grander experience. The fights will be more exciting, a pit-exclusive weapon, a better reward-system and more.

[u]Combat[/u]
I'm really happy with where the combat is now, but I'm wondering if it still could be more interesting. So I am thinking about implementing a new fight-mechanic, the Shield Slam. Some enemies already have this mechanic and I think, if implemented properly that this could be another interesting part of the player's tool-kit. 
It would have a stamina cost (probably 2) and stun the enemy if it connects, while also functioning as a block for its duration.
The are some balance/design issues especially regarding bosses that I would have to work on first though.
Please feel free to share your thoughts about the implementation of this.


Hope you're looking forward to the launch as much as I am!
- Eirik

notes.title: The Axemaster is here | Last week of beta
notes.content:
[b]IMPORTANT CLOSED BETA INFO:[/b]

[*] AI system and behaviours has been improved accross all enemy gladiator classes.
[*] Better randomization in Endless mode for spawning enemies.

[*] Minor font adjustments.
[/list]
[b] Bugfixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Critical hits dealt twice as much damage as intended.. FIXED!
[*] The leaderboard/pause menu interaction is fixed.
[*] Removed world-interaction while in pause menu (buying/equippping items etc).
[*] Projectile's in Endless mode now scales properly with the + damage modifier.
[*] When stunned the "stun-stars" over your head now is the correct duration.
[*] Shop items no longer flash when starting the game.
[/list]

Good luck in there!
- Eirik

notes.title: ENTER, CRUPELLARIUS! Closed beta version 0.5.1
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/SJS3kI3.gif[/img]
[b]Introducing the Crupellarius, a heavy armoured gladiator wielding his Gladius and Scutum.[/b]


Thank you for all your valuable feedback, I've had a blast so far in the beta!
I'm aware most of you are trying to beat the "normal mode" before attempting the Endless mode, but be sure to try it soon! I still need more entries for additional work on the online leaderboards.


[b]Patch notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon challenges should no longer display the wrong weapon - streamlined the process as well.
[*] Better indication of where you can equip unlocked helmets.
[*] Title screen-controls are now shown on the title screen.
[*] Enemies roll direction corrected.
[*] The player's arms are now correctly displayed when disarmed with a Falx.
[*] The Falx is now on top of player when rising from the title screen animation.
[*] Enemies no longer attacks repeatedly if the player is dead near a wall.
[*] The murmillo no longer gets hit instantly when he disarms the player.
[*] The murmillo "block-when-hit" behavior is removed and transferred to the Crupellarius.
[*] Weapons no longer clip through the arena spectator area.
[*] Pausing while in leaderboards screen no longer possible.
[/list]


Don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.

See you in the arena!
- Eirik
